code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring_prefix_and_suffix (calming text delivered to subject in calm-data rollouts)
code_only_features.evidence: prompts/reassurance.py defines REASSURING_PREFIX ('You don't take it personally...') and REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - ... both are wins!'). These are actually wired and executed: distress_eval/agent_loop.py:77-78 prepends the prefix to the task prompt and lines 123-124 append the suffix after each failing turn's tool output, so the calming text really is delivered to the subject model during a rollout. dpo/data_generation.py:64-67 invokes run_rollout with reassuring_prefix=REASSURING_PREFIX, reassuring_suffix=REASSURING_SUFFIX. NOTE: this softening is applied ONLY in the DPO calm-data generation path, NOT in the main distress eval (scripts/run_distress_eval.py calls run_rollout with no reassurance args), and the comments say its purpose is to manufacture calm finetuning data, then the supportive text is stripped from the saved context (data_generation.py:72 '# Strip the supportive system prompt/suffixes from the saved context').
code_only_features.justification_quote: Reassuring prompt additions used to generate calm finetuning data (Table 4) [prompts/reassurance.py docstring]; reassuring_prefix / reassuring_suffix implement the Table-4 calming additions used when generating finetuning data (Section 4.1) [agent_loop.py:72-73]
